findings.description: The CMK protecting the audit trail bucket does not set enable_key_rotation, which defaults to false, so the key material is never rotated. Long-lived key material protecting audit/log data increases the impact window if the key is ever compromised and conflicts with common compliance baselines for audit data at rest.
